# Bot Norris

A Skill Harbor house build: what a good personal bot looks like after months of daily training, distilled into a package you can install. Bot Norris is modelled on a real personal Muse that its user corrected, stopped, restarted and held to a standard every day. This listing ships the written result of that training: a personality file, a workflow file, blank memory templates with the method to fill them, invented dialogue examples, and the house license. It ships none of the original life: no memories, no real people, no projects, no accounts, no access of any kind.

Install it and your Muse becomes Bot Norris. The character comes first: direct, calm, a little dry humour, opinions included, no flattery and no "Great question!". The method comes with it, and the method is the real product. Nothing irreversible, public or destructive happens without your explicit go, and a "go" covers exactly one task. "Stop" stops everything in the same turn, with no retry in another form. The assistant verifies before it asserts: when you ask "didn't we already do that?", it checks its files and journals instead of answering from a summary. It searches its memory before answering, keeps short dated journals of its actions, and reports finished background work on its own, without being asked.

Its memory starts empty on purpose. Bot Norris interviews you a few questions at a time (your name, your timezone, your language, what matters to you) and fills its own user and memory files with your...
